info.name: Emarsys Core API - Email campaigns endpoint batch

items.docs:
Creates an email campaign with the specified parameters.

**Note:** For further information about creating emails with transaction-specific content, see Using the API to Create Triggered Messages and Capturing Transactional Content. For the list of possible campaign related placeholders, see [Email personalization placeholders](docs/personalization/email-personalization-placeholders-legacy.md).

 To disable the automatic link-tracking temporarily when creating an email campaign use `keep_raw_htm

params.name: status
params.description: The status of the campaign. See [Email status and error codes]([Email status and error codes](docs/personalization/email-status-and-error-codes.md)) for details.

params.name: launched
params.description:
Filters campaigns by their launch status.

Supported values:
- *0*: Not launched
- *1*: Launched

params.name: contactlist
params.description: The identifier of the contact list. Set to *0* if no contact list is defined.

params.name: showdeleted
params.description:
Filters deleted campaigns.

Supported values:
- *0*: Deleted campaigns are ignored
- *1*: Lists deleted campaigns as well

params.name: fromdate
params.description: Lists campaigns created after the specified date. Date format: YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: todate
params.description: Lists campaigns created before the specified date. Date format: YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: root_campaign_id
params.description: The identifier of the root campaign ID. Set to *0* if the campaign is not versioned.

params.name: template
params.description: The identifier of the template. Set to *0* if there is no template.

params.name: content_type
params.description:
The type of the content.

**Note:** Multiple values are allowed, separated by a comma without whitespace.

params.name: campaign_type
params.description:
The type of the campaign.

**Note:** Multiple values are allowed, separated by a comma without whitespace.

params.name: parent_campaign_id
params.description: The identifier of the parent campaign. Set to *0* if the email campaign is not a recurring child campaign.

params.name: behavior_channel
params.description: The channel type.

params.name: email_category
params.description:
The identifier of the campaign.

**Note:**  Multiple values are allowed, separated by a comma without whitespace.

params.name: is_rti
params.description:
Specifies whether the campaign supports Interactions.

**Accepted values:** `true`, `false`

items.docs:
Returns a list of existing email campaigns. Filter the results by specifying a campaign by its identifier, set a date range, or use other query parameters. 

**Note:** It is recommended to list campaigns in shorter date ranges when requesting a large amount of data.

params.name: emailId
params.description: The identifier of the campaign.

params.name: raw_text
params.description:
Returns the actual links of the email content with the original URLs instead of the tracking URLs.

**Note:** Using this parameter also affects the `html_source` and `text_source` fields in the response.

items.docs: Returns the details of an email campaign, such as content and attributes, including personalized text and HTML source.
Returns a list of languages available for creating emails. For a list of supported languages, see [Language codes](docs/appendix/language-codes.md).
Returns the alphabetized list of email campaign categories available for creating email campaigns.

info.name: Update an Email Campaign Recipient Source

params.name: emailId
params.description: The identifier of the email campaign.

items.docs:
You must set the **Recipient source** setting to **Using the API** in the Emarsys application to assign a segment or a contact list to an email campaign using the API.

The recipient source is filtered by the specified segment or contact list. To narrow the recipient list further, provide exclusion filters.

**Important:** If you do not explicitly set any exclusion filters, all existing exclusions are removed from the campaign.

**Warning:** The recipient source parameter can only be changed onc

params.name: emailId
params.description: The identifier of the campaign.

items.docs:
Updates an email campaign with the specified parameters.

Email campaigns are locked during updates to prevent overlapping concurrent updates that may cause problems. A new update process can be started **only** after the one in progress has finished. You cannot make an update request while there is an on-going update. 

**Note:** Already launched campaigns cannot be modified.

**Important:** This endpoint **does not** work with VCE campaigns. Updating VCE campaigns must be done through the UI.

params.name: emailId
params.description: The identifier of the email campaign.

items.docs:
Creates a new child version of the specified email campaign.

Versioned campaigns are optimal for A/B testing, and can be manipulated as a separate email campaign through the API.

**Tip:** List all versions of an email campaign with `root_campaign_id` filter on the [List email campaigns](https://dev.emarsys.com/docs/emarsys-api/b3A6MjQ4OTk4Njg) endpoint.

params.name: emailId
params.description: The identifier of the email campaign.

items.docs:
During A/B testing of multi-language campaigns, two versions are sent to contacts with the same mother tongue living in the same country. Once the A/B testing is completed, finalize the email campaign using this endpoint. Contacts in the specified countries will then receive the successful version in their own languages.

**Note:** This endpoint is only available if the *Multi-language Email Campaigns* feature is enabled for your account. Contact Emarsys Support for details.

params.description: The identifier of the email campaign.

Adds emails and domains to the internal blocklist. Blocklisted entries are not participating in any campaign.

**Note:** The maximum batch size is 1000 emails and 1000 domains per call.

info.name: List AC Programs That Use an Email Campaign

params.name: campaign_id
params.description: The id of the campaign used by the AC programs you want to get.

items.docs: Returns a list of AC programs that use the specified email campaign.
